about_the_game:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Keep the park running, protect the local ecosystem, and support the people who visit it.

Handle a wide range of ranger duties and ensure park rules are respected. One moment, you may be completing routine maintenance. The next, you could be searching for a missing hiker or responding to an urgent wildlife callout.

Faremont’s diverse landscape stretches from dense forests and open meadows to winding rivers. Use your ranger vehicles to travel along the park’s road network and reach remote areas filled with waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

Protecting Faremont’s wildlife is one of your most important responsibilities. Track animals across the wilderness, rescue wildlife in distress, and secure traps before they can cause further harm. Use specialized ranger equipment to follow signals, safely approach animals, and respond to each situation with care.

From elusive wolves and imposing bison to mischievous raccoons, a diverse range of wildlife brings Faremont National Park to life. Observe animal behavior through your camera, discover new species, and expand your personal wildlife lexicon as you explore.

Your responsibility also extends to Faremont’s visitors. Guide hikers, check permits, respond to emergencies, and investigate suspicious behavior. Handle incidents such as vandalism, prohibited items, littering, or disturbances to keep the park safe and welcoming.

Beyond urgent callouts, you’ll inspect plant health, remove invasive growth, restore affected areas, clean campsites, restock supplies, and transport materials across the park. Every completed task contributes to your park rating, unlocking new missions and equipment as your ranger career progresses.

Put on your ranger hat and begin your journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator.

  • STEP INTO THE WILD: Begin your ranger career in the stunning Faremont National Park

  • EXPLORE THE PARK: Discover forests, meadows, riversides, scenic landmarks, and remote locations

  • PROTECT WILDLIFE: Track animals, rescue wildlife in distress, secure dangerous traps, and document species with your camera

  • SUPPORT VISITORS: Help hikers, check permits, inspect backpacks for prohibited items, and respond to emergencies or suspicious behavior

  • CARE FOR FAREMONT: Maintain trails, protect plant life, remove invasive species, clean campsites, restock supplies, and complete transport tasks

  • USE RANGER EQUIPMENT: Follow tracking signals and handle wildlife, maintenance, and investigation tasks with specialized tools

  • BUILD YOUR RANGER CAREER: Improve your park rating and unlock new missions and equipment

  • EXPERIENCE DYNAMIC DAYS: Adapt to changing weather, shifting tasks, and unexpected callouts
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-12100F (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (3.6 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2060 8GB or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please note that Integrated Graphics are not supported (e.g. Laptops). For 720p gaming (setting needs to be adjusted manually in the game options): GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580 8GB
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900 (12 Core) or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (12GB) or AMD Radeon RX 7000 (16GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please note that Integrated Graphics are not supported (e.g. Laptops).
